subject: Deducer 0.7-4 on CRAN and Introducing DeducerText

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Deducer 0.7-4 on CRAN and Introducing DeducerText
parts:
Deducer 0.7-4 has been released to CRAN along with a new Deducer
add-on called DeducerText.


-------------------------------------------------------


This Deducer release involves mostly improvements to the back-end and
should make the use of JGR/Deducer more robust. Perhaps the most
notable change is that Deducer's Data Viewer can now handle millions
of rows and tens of thousands of columns smoothly.


Changes:
o Plot builder: "drop" defaults to TRUE in scales
o Plot builder: Fixed issue where save would rarely fail
o Plot builder: corrected required aes for errorbarh (Thanks to
Manuel Spinola for the report)
(Thanks to Matthew Ockendon for the report)
o Updated for ggplot 0.9.2
o Data viewer does lazy loading, and can thus now handle data with
millions of rows and thousands of
columns
o Added: "GUI Add-ons" menu item to select common general purpose
Deducer Add-on packages.
o Moved many interactions from Java with R off the GUI event thread,
and most calls to R are now cancelable if they take too much time.


-------------------------------------------------------


DeducerText is a new Deducer Add-on focused on Text Mining. It
provides dialogs for text import, processing and visualization. Here
is a youtube video showing it in action (only slightly out of date:

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QMMuoI1jbog


-------------------------------------------------------


Also, JGR has also been updated with a brand new Object Browser which
I hope that you will like. Here is a little video I made during the
development process:

http://neolab.stat.ucla.edu/cranstats/object_browser_demo.mov


-------------------------------------------------------
